audit.why: breakdown.difficulty (Favoured 4/10) matches content's early/mid Alistar-favoured framing.
Level 2 W-Q kill window and level 6 Unbreakable Will dive-through-heals are both real, kit-grounded spikes; late-game correctly flags Wish (R) as the race-the-clock threat.
The silence-then-root sequencing of Equinox (E) and the Astral Infusion (W) self-damage-heal mechanic are both already stated correctly in the content prose.

edits.before: - Soraka Equinox: matchup-defining — The silence zone cancels your engage mid-cast — step out before the root snaps. It writes your spacing rules. - R Unbreakable Will is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Soraka's Equinox (E) is down 20s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — the silence zone cancels your engage mid-cast; step out before the root snaps. - R Unbreakable Will is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Land W-Q on Soraka herself, not her ADC — she has no dash or hard CC, so a caught engage on her is nearly free.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Holding for a perfect wave just lets Soraka's Starcall poke and self-heal chip your lead back down.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mobility-Mercs by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mobility-Mercs by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.
